description: Resume a suspended task by providing the answer to its pending clarification question. Triggered automatically by clarification.answered EventBus events.

question_id.description: The pending_question_id from the suspended checkpoint. Matches the correlation_id in the clarification.answered event.

answer.description: The answer to inject into the suspended task's conversation history.

answered_by.description: Node ID or name of the entity that provided the answer. Used for logging and audit.
